Terms for using the American Clothing Restoration website.

Website Use

This website provides general information about American Clothing Restoration and its clothing and textile restoration services. The information is not a guarantee of service availability, outcome, turnaround time, insurance coverage, or restoration result.

Service Information

Textile restoration depends on the material, damage, condition, and professional evaluation of the item. Replacement may be appropriate when restoration is not practical.

No Online Contract

Using this website does not create a service agreement. For questions about a loss, call American Clothing Restoration directly.
